# AtroUI

> Dark-first React / Next.js catalog on the official shadcn registry. MIT. You own the copied files.
> Install: npx shadcn@latest add @atroui/home-hero  (any @atroui/… item)
> Public namespace @atroui — listed in https://ui.shadcn.com/r/registries.json — no GitHub token, not a private GitHub registry.
> Tailwind CSS v4 (not v3 @apply / opacity syntax).
> Optional Host APIs (npm i atroui + transpilePackages): contact, waitlist, newsletter, OG, thumbnail, scope. BYOK: SMTP/Resend, Hugging Face/Gemini/xAI. AtroUI never holds keys and does not run paid AI on atroui.com. Missing keys → 503 on the consumer app.
> Host APIs: https://www.atroui.com/docs/host-api
> Compare (not Magic UI / Aceternity): https://www.atroui.com/docs/compare
> Site: https://www.atroui.com
> Registry JSON: https://www.atroui.com/r/{name}.json
> Repo: https://github.com/atroui/atroui
> npm (package atroui): https://www.npmjs.com/package/atroui

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest init
npx shadcn@latest add @atroui/home-hero
```

`@atroui` is in the official shadcn registry directory. No manual `registry add` URL step.
